svg.text: Dotnet · D30 · Name the anomaly, then a short atomic fix
Locks last as long as the TX
No HTTP, no email, no 'just one more call' inside the transaction.
An HTTP call is not a database operation.
A deadlock is a wait cycle
Victim retry is recovery. Order is the fix.
★ Retry the victim. Then normalize access order and shorten TX.
Last-unit oversell dies in a single UPDATE.
two readers cannot both decrement the last unit
Anomaly first, then isolation or SQL.

text.tspan: Hold a transaction across remote I/O
Raise isolation as the first fix
